catalog_hash_definition.input: compact UTF-8 JSON encoding of every tool definition published in tools[], including name, description, inputSchema and outputSchema, with object keys in lexicographic order and array order preserved

description_bound_definition.scope_rule: Each description in the frozen in-scope manifest is measured on its own, and a value at or below both limits passes.
description_bound_definition.unit: one description, counted as Unicode scalar values and cl100k_base tokens

tools.description: Trigger the maintenance wave: dirty-path refresh, eligible hub distillation, and reconcile of the bank's consolidated units; never blocks leaf writes. The same structural maintenance also runs automatically: the runtime's maintenance trigger checks each bank's pressure and fires when that pressure crosses the thresholds, subject to the cooldown; the thresholds and cooldown are tunable. This tool remains the deterministic, caller-invoked path.

bank.description: Target bank for the maintenance wave; defaults to the injected bank.

force.description: Run the full forced maintenance wave: refresh every dirty ancestor, then reconcile the bank's consolidated units.

tools.name: consolidate

tools.description: Exact fetch by id (metadata + refs). A soft-deleted item is still returned, marked by two top-level booleans: `discarded` (operations removal) and `archived` (hygiene archive). A hub-distilled unit also carries a `freshness` key: its proof count, last reconciliation, stale state and reason, and the per-revision evidence trail (source ids and times only).

bank.description: Isolation key; overrides the connection default when present.

tools.name: get

tools.description: Return the authoritative structured snapshot only. It also carries two top-level booleans: `discarded` (operations removal) and `archived` (hygiene archive).

bank.description: Isolation key; overrides the connection default when present.

tools.name: get_snapshot

tools.description: Return the non-authoritative prose gist only. It also carries two top-level booleans: `discarded` (operations removal) and `archived` (hygiene archive).

bank.description: Isolation key; overrides the connection default when present.

tools.name: get_gist

tools.description: Regenerate the prose gist for one item (`scope` = item id) or every active item in the resolved bank (`scope` = "bank") from existing snapshots; snapshots are never altered. Archived and discarded items are reported as skipped, never summarized.

bank.description: Isolation key; overrides the connection default when present.

dry_run.description: Report the gists that would be regenerated without persisting them.

scope.description: Item id, or the literal string "bank" for the whole resolved bank.

tools.name: summarize

tools.description: Report leaf queryability, dirty/refreshing ancestors, pressure and trigger blocks; failures are reported, not fatal.

bank.description: Isolation key; overrides the connection default when present.

tools.name: maintenance_status

tools.description: List items with epistemic_kind, scores, validity windows, and optional source context for authorized readers (never payloads/DEKs).

bank.description: Isolation key; overrides the connection default when present.

filter.description: Optional structured item filter (all fields optional).

item_id.description: Optional item id: when present, inspect adds a read-only supersession section for this item

query.description: Required when item_id is present: the query the supersession check ranks the correction's lineage against

tools.name: inspect

tools.description: Reconstruct value/confidence/evidence history with lineage traversal.

bank.description: Isolation key; overrides the connection default when present.

item_id.description: Item id (any revision in the lineage).

tools.name: audit_trail

tools.description: Read one scratchpad key, or the whole session scratchpad when key is omitted.

bank.description: Isolation key; overrides the connection default when present.

session.description: Session scope (defaults to the connection session).

tools.name: scratchpad_read

tools.description: Read the currently active slot value, or a historical value at `as_of`.

bank.description: Isolation key; overrides the connection default when present.

tools.name: canonical_get

tools.description: Hybrid search scoped exclusively to the shared bank.

bank.description: Isolation key; overrides the connection default when present.

tools.name: shared_retrieve

tools.description: Read-only memory counts by bank, tier, category, age band, and provenance class. Two lists: `by_age_band` buckets active items by age in half-life units (the unit is the retention half-life in days, and each band's boundaries in days appear in its label), and `by_provenance_class` counts user_stated, agent_inferred, third_party, and fact. Pressure counts (flagged, stale summaries, archive candidates) appear when their sources answer, and a count that cannot be answered is left out rather than shown as zero. Tier is the semantic-versus-episodic split (semantic is category-scoped, episodic is the remainder) and nothing else.

bank.description: Isolation key; overrides the connection default when present.

tools.name: stats

tools.description: Read-only ranked noise scan: candidates by descending hygiene_noise_score with masked previews; never mutates memory.

bank.description: Isolation key; overrides the connection default when present.

offset.description: Offset into the ranked candidate list.

tools.name: hygiene_audit

tools.description: Confirmed cleanup: flag | archive | discard (delete alias, non-compliance) | apply_suggested (apply each candidate's suggested_action; a keep suggestion is skipped). Without confirm=true: dry-run counts only, zero writes. Never performs compliance erasure or DEK destruction.

action.description: Requested action; `delete` is the documented non-compliance alias of `discard`.

bank.description: Isolation key; overrides the connection default when present.

confirm.description: Perform the mutations; default false (dry-run counts only).

reason.description: Non-empty removal reason for confirmed discard.

tools.name: hygiene_clean

tools.description: Masked durable hygiene-log rows (one row per item per clean action); every cleanup is reconstructible without secret leakage.

bank.description: Isolation key; overrides the connection default when present.

tools.name: hygiene_log_list

tools.description: Read-only install/database health snapshot: backend reachability, schema version, banks, index coverage counts, and embedding readiness. Never mutates memory. A bound caller's `bank`, when it passes one, selects the bank inside its grant, and a caller without a credential gets the whole store whatever it passes.

bank.description: Bank; omitted=server default the credential grant must cover. A caller without a credential reads the whole store.

tools.name: diagnose

tools.description: Deeper read-only consistency pass over referential integrity and index coverage; aggregate ok is false when any error-severity finding exists. A pass for a named bank is also not ok while another bank carries an error finding, and names those codes in notes; a bound caller's pass reads no other bank and so carries no such note.

bank.description: Bank; omitted=server default the credential grant must cover. A caller without a credential reads the whole store.

tools.name: verify

tools.description: Compose an ordered repair plan from verify findings. Default dry_run=true prints the plan and registers nothing; dry_run=false registers the plan and returns its id without touching the store.

bank.description: Bank; omitted=server default the credential grant must cover. A caller without a credential composes the whole store.

dry_run.description: Print the plan only (default true); false registers a concrete plan id.

tools.name: doctor

tools.description: Apply allowlisted repairs from a doctor plan id or an explicit action list. confirm=true is required to mutate; unknown actions are refused and successful runs re-verify and report residual findings.

actions.description: Explicit allowlisted action ids (used when plan_id is omitted).

bank.description: Bank; omitted=plan's bank or credential default. Plan outside grant: not found; no bank/plan fails.

tools.name: repair

tools.description: Rebuild derived dense and/or lexical indexes. confirm=true is the live switch and starts the rebuild; dry_run is report-only, defaulting to the opposite of confirm, so a report-only run applies nothing and is not reported as ok. A live dense rebuild also needs an embedding sidecar.

bank.description: Bank; omitted=server default the credential grant must cover. Unbound sweeps indexes; MCP rejects if shared bank off.

confirm.description: Start the live rebuild; default false.

dry_run.description: Report only; applies nothing and is not ok. Defaults to the opposite of `confirm`. `false` without `confirm: true` is refused.

target.description: Which derived indexes to rebuild (default all).

tools.name: reindex

tools.description: Show the effective per-bank retention profile, its source, the optional retention mission (statement and example counts when set), and the fields stored but not yet honored.

bank.description: Isolation key; overrides the connection default when present.

tools.name: retention_profile_get

tools.description: Validate and store a per-bank retention profile; without confirm=true it previews the change and writes nothing.

match.description: Match discriminator; literal is the case-insensitive substring default.

reject.description: Drop entries only: a hit rejects the write outright. Keep entries ignore this.

text.description: A literal substring, or a pinned-subset regex when match is regex.

bank.description: Isolation key; overrides the connection default when present.

confirm.description: Confirm the profile change; without it nothing is stored.

profile.description: Retention profile object (verbosity, theta_offsets, duplicate tolerances, recall scope, retention curve and floor, pack fidelity, provenance floor, maintenance trigger, version) plus an optional mission: keep/drop examples that steer admission deterministically.

duplicate_tolerance_read.description: Read-time page similarity cap. Strict caps token-set Jaccard at 0.80, balanced at 0.90, lenient at 0.95; the neutral balanced default caps nothing unless a scope preset or prefer_consolidated is active.

duplicate_tolerance_write.description: Admission-time novelty cutoff. strict rejects token-set similarity >= 0.75; balanced and lenient add no extra cutoff.

maintenance_trigger.description: On/off switch for the maintenance trigger. On by default.

mission.description: Optional deterministic retention mission: keep/drop examples that steer admission scoring. Admission influence is arithmetic only; mission text is never passed to any model.

drop_examples.description: Patterns whose hits subtract 0.30 from the utility factor; reject=true entries (the default) reject outright with mission_drop:<rule_id>.

keep_examples.description: Patterns whose hits add +0.15 to the utility factor; never rescues a gate or span-verification failure.

mission_statement.description: Human-readable mission statement (what to keep, what to drop, and the tie-break).

pack_fidelity_default.description: Default pack fidelity channel: flow (the default) or exact.

provenance_floor_default.description: Optional floor on the provenance rung admitted when a caller sets none. Null means no floor; an unknown rung is refused.

recall_scope_default.description: Default recall scope honored by retrieve/compose when the call omits recall_scope. consolidated_only returns eligible consolidated units only.

retention_curve.description: Whether the retention curve shapes ranked results: each candidate's shaped score is multiplied by its age factor, never below retention_floor. On by default.

retention_floor.description: Lowest multiplier the retention curve may apply, in (0, 1]. Must be finite; 0 is refused, 1 is accepted.

theta_offsets.description: Bounded per-category delta added on top of the verbosity delta (abs(delta) <= 0.20).

verbosity.description: Admission strictness. selective raises theta by 0.08 and sets a 0.15 novelty floor; balanced is the unchanged default; permissive lowers theta by 0.08.

scope.description: Write scope; deployment sets the default for banks without an override.

tools.name: retention_profile_set
